title: TLS verification disabled in EarnApp qualification probe (remediated)
description: The historical probe accepted a forged WSS qualification response because certificate and hostname verification were disabled. The current worktree requires normal certificate-chain and hostname validation before qualification evidence can be accepted.
root_cause: build_tls_context in app/proxy_probe_profiles/earnapp.py did not require certificate and hostname verification, allowing forged qualification evidence
intended_behavior: Only the authenticated EarnApp provider endpoint should be able to produce CID_SET qualification evidence.

trace.description: Creates the SSL context used by the qualification probe.
Requires hostname verification and a trusted certificate chain.
The verified context prevents forged WSS qualification frames from entering the eligibility path.

conditions.description: The attacker must intercept or terminate the probe's WSS connection.

execution.attacker_perspective: A network attacker able to intercept the probe connection.
payloads: Forged WSS CID_SET response from an untrusted certificate.
instructions: Observe whether the probe accepts it.
execution.expected_result: The current verified TLS context rejects the untrusted endpoint before qualification evidence is accepted.

remediation.strategy: Require certificate-chain and hostname verification for the provider WSS endpoint.

likelihood.reason: Requires network interception but qualification runs against remote infrastructure.

impact.reason: Could mark an attacker-controlled proxy as eligible for EarnApp traffic.

confidence.reason: The historical configuration and persistence path were directly traced; current regression tests cover the remediation.
